sentences.text: Eostriatolamia was an extinct shark belonging to the family Odontaspididae and the class Chondrichthyes.
The genus was first described by Gluckman in 1980.
The species Eostriatolamia paucicorrugata was described in 2010 by Underwood and Cumbaa from Cenomanian rocks in Canada.
There are 88 recorded fossil occurrences of Eostriatolamia in the Paleobiology Database.
This animal lived from the Tithonian to the Maastrichtian stages, between 149.2 and 66 million years ago.
